name: t drill
description: A cone drill in a T shape that trains sprinting, side shuffling and backpedaling.
instructions: Set four cones in a T with the top cones 5 yards apart.
Sprint forward to the center cone and touch it.
Shuffle sideways to the left cone and touch it.
Shuffle across to the right cone, then back to the middle.
Keep your hips low and feet from crossing.
